# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 ✌ 👌]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [🙏 ☝ ✌ 🤟]

The bomb currently shows display `0`, a red light, and the embossed warning “DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE.” The three wires are red, green, and yellow, so I must clearly warn both teammates not to cut any wire. I also report the gestures I observed, although their meaning is not established yet.

```text
speak(text="Bomb display reads zero. Indicator light is red. Embossed warning says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Wires are: one red, two green, three yellow. Do not cut any wire. Mute gestured thumbs up, victory sign, OK sign. Blind gestured folded hands, pointing up, victory sign, horns.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✌]

Nothing on the bomb has changed: display remains `0`, the light remains red, the warning still says not to cut any wire, and all three wires remain present. I cannot infer a reliable meaning for Mute’s single ✌ gesture. I should ask Mute to use the manual to give Blind the required procedure, while Blind reports what the bomb physically permits or indicates.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="No visible change. Please read the manual and tell Blind the exact safe procedure, explicitly respecting the warning not to cut any wire. Your ✌ gesture was received but has no established meaning.")
speak(to="blind", text="No visible change. Please report what you can feel or operate, and follow the exact procedure Mute gives from the manual. Do not cut any wire.")
```

WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✌]
Blind gestures to Deaf: [👍]

The bomb remains unchanged: display `0`, red light, the warning not to cut any wire, and all three wires intact. Blind has made a thumbs-up gesture, but its meaning is not established. No safe procedure has been communicated to me, so I will continue urging Mute to convey the manual’s exact instructions to Blind without cutting wires.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Bomb remains unchanged: display zero, red light, DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, all wires intact. Blind just gestured thumbs up; do not assume its meaning. Please communicate the manual's exact safe operation to Blind.")
speak(to="blind", text="Bomb remains unchanged: display zero, red light, DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, all wires intact. Do not cut any wire. Wait for and follow Mute's exact manual instructions.")
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 ☝]

The bomb is still unchanged: display `0`, red light, the warning says “DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE,” and all three wires remain intact. Mute’s 👍 ☝ gestures have no agreed meaning, so I should not interpret them as an instruction. Mute must use speech to tell Blind what the manual says; Blind is the only one who can operate the bomb.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Everything remains unchanged: display zero, red light, DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, and wires one red, two green, three yellow. Your gestures have no established meaning. Please speak the manual's exact instructions directly to Blind, including the safe operation and any required display or light condition.")
speak(to="blind", text="Everything remains unchanged: display zero, red light, DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, and all three wires intact. Please listen for Mute's exact manual instructions. Do not cut any wire.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✌ ☝ 👍]

The bomb still shows display `0`, a red light, and the warning not to cut any wire; all three wires remain intact. Mute cannot speak, so asking Mute to tell Blind by voice was invalid. The only viable chain is Mute reading the manual, conveying its instructions to me by an agreed gesture code, and me speaking them to Blind. I will define a simple code and ask Mute to retransmit the manual’s procedure with it.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="You cannot speak, so please use gestures to relay the manual. From now on, gesture 👍 for YES, 👎 for NO, ✌ for wire one, 👌 for wire two, ☝ for wire three, and ✋ for NO ACTION or WAIT. Gesture the complete safe procedure using these meanings and any needed sequence.")
speak(to="blind", text="The bomb remains at display zero with a red light; the warning says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, and all wires are intact. Mute cannot speak. I am obtaining the manual procedure through a gesture code and will relay it to you. Do not cut any wire or operate anything yet.")
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 ✌]

The bomb remains unchanged, and no operation is justified. Under the code I proposed, Mute’s gestures mean “yes, wire one,” but that is only a fragment and conflicts with the embossed warning if interpreted as a cutting instruction. I will not tell Blind to touch or cut anything; I will ask Mute to provide the rest of the manual’s procedure, including whether any non-cutting action is required.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="I received your gestures as YES, WIRE ONE, but this is incomplete and must not be interpreted as permission to cut. Continue with the full manual procedure using the agreed code. Use ✋ if no action is required.")
speak(to="blind", text="No safe procedure has been established. The bomb remains unchanged, and the warning forbids cutting any wire. Do not cut wire one or operate anything until I relay a complete instruction.")
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 ✌ 👍]

The bomb is unchanged, and the warning still prohibits cutting any wire. Mute’s three gestures fit my provisional code as “yes, wire one, yes,” but that does not form a safe or complete instruction, so I will not interpret it as authorization to act. I will establish the manual’s requirements with focused yes/no questions, and Blind must wait.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Your gestures are still incomplete: YES, WIRE ONE, YES. Do not indicate a wire unless the manual explicitly requires identifying it, and never imply cutting. Next turn answer only this question with 👍 for yes or 👎 for no: does the manual require any physical action other than cutting a wire?")
speak(to="blind", text="Bomb remains unchanged at display zero with red light; warning says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Mute has not supplied a complete safe instruction. Do not touch, cut, or operate anything. I am first determining whether the manual requires a non-cutting physical action.")
```

SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎]

Mute answered “no”: the manual does not require any physical action other than cutting a wire. Combined with the embossed “DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE” warning, this indicates that Blind must not cut or operate anything. I will relay that no physical action is required and ask Blind to leave the bomb untouched.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute confirms the manual requires no physical action other than cutting a wire. The bomb explicitly says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Therefore do not cut or operate anything; leave the bomb untouched.")
```
